items.q: How do I make sure the QR code scans well?
items.a: Keep strong contrast between the code and background, leave a clear border and test it with two or three phones before printing.

items.q: Can I change the link inside a QR code later?
items.a: No. These are static codes, so the content is fixed. If the link may change, create the code for a page you control and redirect that page.

items.q: Is the QR code generator free?
items.a: Yes. The QR code maker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Can you help me connect offline marketing to online?
items.a: Yes. Our team can plan tracked links, landing pages and campaigns for flyers and shops.
